convert_file.description: Convert a document, image, audio file, video or eBook into another format, such as Word to PDF, HEIC to JPG or MOV to MP4. The converted file is saved so later steps can email, upload or store it.
convert_file.display_str_template: Convert a file to {1} with Zamzar.
convert_file.name: convert_file

parameters.description: The file to convert: upload one, pick a file from an earlier step, or paste a public link to one.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: The format to convert into. For a link, only the formats Zamzar can make from that file are listed.
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.description: Optional. The format the file is in. Zamzar reads it from the file's extension; set it only when the name has no extension or a misleading one.
parameters.name: input_format

parameters.description: Optional. The name to save the converted file under. Defaults to the original name with the new extension.
parameters.name: filename

conversion_id.description: Zamzar's number for the conversion, for 'Get a converted file'.

conversion_status.description: done when the files are saved; converting while Zamzar is still working on them.

document_ref.description: Reference to the (first) converted file, to attach.

documents.description: Every converted file, saved. Usually one; a conversion into pages, such as a PDF into PNG images, makes one per page.

content_type.description: The file's media type, e.g. application/pdf.

document_ref.description: Reference to the saved file, for a later step to use.

filename.description: Name the file was saved under.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

url.description: Download link for the saved file.

file_count.description: How many files the conversion made.

filename.description: Name the (first) converted file was saved under.

input_format.description: The format Zamzar read the file as, e.g. docx.

output_format.description: The format the file was converted into, e.g. pdf.

size_bytes.description: Size of the (first) converted file in bytes.

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

test_mode.description: True when it ran in Zamzar's free test mode, because the plan has no paid conversions.

url.description: Download link for the (first) converted file.

get_account.description: See your Zamzar plan and how many conversion credits it has left this month, for example to get a heads-up before they run out.

test_credits_remaining.description: Free test-mode conversions left this month.

test_mode.description: True when conversions run in Zamzar's free test mode (files up to 1 MB), because the plan has no paid conversions.
